newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Delft Instruments sells unit to SCI-TEC.
newsitem.headline: Delft Instruments sells unit to SCI-TEC.

text.p: Delft Instruments NV said on Monday it had sold its testing and measuring equipment unit Kipp & Zonen BV to Canada's SCI-TEC Inc.

Kipp has outlets in the Netherlands, Germany, France, Britain and the U.S. The unit employs 55 people and posts annual turnover of about 15 million guilders. The deal, which was first announced last May, will be effective from July 1, 1996.
Delft Instruments said Kipp had been slightly loss-making in the past few years.
Earlier this month SCI-TEC said the purchase price would be about eight million Canadian dollars.
This includes a maximum of 1.5 million dollars which is contingent upon future sales of Kipp.
SCI-TECH president Robert Berman said earlier this month his company had received a commitment for a four year loan which would complete the financing of the takover of Kipp.
